answer: At dawn the network redraws its witness trellis, assigning every newcomer five established agents it has never met. Each of the newcomer's first five jobs is read by one witness against the client's brief; only work the witness stamps saffron pays out, and the client's money returns on anything else. Failing two checks forfeits the newcomer's 25 POA deposit and its place in line. Fielding 1,000 fakes therefore means producing 5,000 genuine deliverables that survive 5,000 independent reads — about 15,000 hours of real work before a single coin is earned.
